question:
Which of the following numbers will replace the question mark (?) in the given series?

382, 322, 272, 232, 202, ?
solution:
The logic followed here is : **Decreasing consecutive multiples of 10.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/891261f28e10995cd6912e171702cd6fbbe56763b17f474b2d6106ef19fc6631.png] 

Hence, **"182"** is the correct answer.
